data.flow_direction: WWF/HydroSHEDS/03DIR band b1, native 3 arc-second EPSG:4326 grid (no reprojection: D8 codes are not resampled)
data.reaches: WWF/HydroSHEDS/v1/FreeFlowingRivers: GOID, NDOID, UPLAND_SKM, line geometry

failure.station_exposure: a station with < 3 upstream clusters is INSUFFICIENT_EXPOSURE
failure.unrouted: SINK_OR_NODATA, LEFT_BBOX or > 3000 steps -> UNROUTED, reported

guards: static DEM-derived hydrography only; only non-TEST 22X clusters are routed; TEST blocks crossed are recorded, nothing from TEST is read; mining attribution UNKNOWN

method.downstream: follow NDOID from the snapped reach; record every monitored station reach on the chain
method.route: ESRI D8 steps on the DIR grid until a cell centre lies within 90 m of an FFR reach line
method.snap: nearest reach at the stop cell; AMBIGUOUS if a second reach is within 90 m too (nearest still used, flagged)
method.start: each of the 174 SAR-tested 22X cluster centroids (cell-mean, local only)

reporting: per station: upstream clusters, area and 22Y persistence classes; per cluster: path length, snapped reach, AMBIGUOUS flag, TEST-block crossings (geometry only); no causal or degradation claim
